name: Vision Transformer classifier
description: One class per patch, from a transformer that looks at the whole patch at once. It works at a fixed 224 px and wants more examples than the others. Starts from a network already trained on everyday photographs, so it learns from few examples.

settings.label: Epochs
settings.help: How many times the model sees every training image.

settings.label: Image size (px)
settings.help: This network only takes 224 px images.

settings.label: Batch size
settings.help: Images per step. Lower it if the run fails with 'out of memory'.

settings.label: Learning rate
settings.help: How big each learning step is. The default suits most projects.
